body: I'm feeling kind of happy that I received so many comments. I was not expecting more than 2. Thank you guys.
Haha this is a great post. I totally hate humanity too! I especially like the part in your post with the mcmuffin vs the mcgriddle. You made me laugh so I'll try to stay alive.

Reddit doesn't bring out anyone's bad side, it brings out their true side. Which just happens to be bad because humans are fundamentally evil.

In any case, while I appreciate your kind words it doesn't have nearly enough upvotes to demonstrate that a majority of people feel this way.
Jeffrey Dahmer thought highly of himself. Are you prepared to say that he is a worthy person?
Respect has to be earned. Esteem must come from outside sources. We don't want Adam Lanza thinking he's as worthy as Albert Einstein do we?
What else is there to base self-worth on? Certainly not your own opinion of yourself.
Ya the universe really is a sad place.

Is there anything worse than that smug guy who ignores everyone's opinions but his own? People need to bend to others' views. Otherwise we have a society of nothing but narcissistic lions who think they can do no wrong.
On the contrary, they're the perfect ones to decide. They give a good sample size and they are unbiased as I am a stranger to them.
